addons.description: Standalone manager for playtime, daily streak, and weekly attendance-based G0 instant airdrops. addons.name: Dune Chat Monitor
addons.description: Read-only live and history monitor for Dune: Awakening chat. The version-pinned companion collector follows dune-text-router Docker logs, persists allowed chat history in its own SQLite database, and exports generated UI JSON/history under the Console addon's web/live/ directory. Private/direct Whispers are excluded from both SQLite persistence and JSON exports.
